1.note: rooms exist (order:<id>) but have no membership list and no metadata; access is a token capability, so "who is in the channel" is our server's list plus presence. Sendbird has members and data on the channel

2.note: messages.send({ text, metadata: { type: 'order_card', card } }); the server edits as the message's author with a message-update-own token (a default API key lacks message-update-any: 'client is not message owner'); message.updated on both sides

3.note: the documented custom before-publish moderation hook (and the Hive/Tisane/Bodyguard/Azure integrations) did not appear in this app's Integrations page, so no rule could be created: 0/4 blocked at run time. Reporting, muting and banning: unavailable ('coming soon')
3.gate: moderation rules not offered in the dashboard for this Free app; Ably support

4.note: no email; browser push via the Web Push API with Ably-generated VAPID keys; webhooks for your own notifier

6.note: no membership to add anyone to: the agent's token already covers order:* rooms, so escalation is an access-control fact plus the agent attaching; history is messages.history (Free plan: 1-day retention)

7.note: typing is native (keystroke/stop/subscribe). Read receipts: not a Chat SDK feature (we put lastReadSerial in presence data to run the check; counts as unavailable for the comparison). Attachments: no upload or storage (we inlined a data URL; unavailable for the comparison)
